recipe.variant: RealESRGAN_x4plus: the official template default for photos / realistic frames
recipe.from_template: utility-gan_upscaler (UpscaleModelLoader -> ImageUpscaleWithModel, the video template's upscale stage applied to a still) + docs.comfy.org/tutorials/basic/upscale (Load Upscale Model -> Upscale Image (using Model)); esrgan_example (archived) is the same two nodes after a txt2img pass.

upscale_model.note: any file in models/upscale_models; output size = input x the model's own fixed scale. Photo alternatives in profile.files: 4x_foolhardy_Remacri.pth (more detail, less smoothing; NC), 4xNomos8kDAT.pth / 4xNomos2_hq_dat2.pth / 4xRealWebPhoto_v4_dat2.safetensors (DAT, higher fidelity, slower), 003_realSR_BSRGAN_DFO_s64w8_SwinIR-M_x4_GAN.pth (SwinIR, natural textures), BSRGAN.pth (text, sharp edges), realesr-general-x4v3.pth (compact, fastest), RealESRGAN_x2plus.pth (2x)

image.note: the still to enlarge; output = input size x 4 (the model's fixed scale). Feed RGB on 0.35.0: the RGBA crash in ImageUpscaleWithModel was fixed in v0.38.0.

recipe.defaults_note: 4x, no other parameters: ImageUpscaleWithModel tiles internally at 512 px / 32 overlap and halves the tile on OOM down to 128 px; speed, not VRAM, is the limit. 'It can't create new detail like diffusion can, but it's much faster.'

vram_evidence.usage: NOT FOUND (no official VRAM table; ImageUpscaleWithModel tiles internally at 512 px / 32 overlap and halves the tile on OOM down to 128 px, so any CUDA GPU runs it; speed, not VRAM, is the limit)

verify: PASSED offline structural check against the v0.35.0 registry on 2026-10-01 (classes, input keys incl. dynamic combos, links/types, enums, ranges, output node). Not yet run on a box.

The offline validator accepts only .safetensors/.gguf/.pt model names, so the recipe names a .safetensors build; the .pth models in profile.files are drop-in swaps on the box (ComfyUI loads .pth through spandrel) via the upscale_model port.
